question: The scientific study of dreams is called ______.
solution:
The correct answer is __**oneirology**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Oneirology**

 
 
• **​It is the scientific study of dreams. Hence, Option 2 is correct.**
 
• Current research seeks correlations between dreaming and current knowledge about the functions of the brain, as well as an understanding of how the brain works during dreaming as pertains to memory formation and mental disorders.
 
• The study of oneirology can be distinguished from dream analysis in that the aim is to quantitatively study the process of dreams instead of analyzing the meaning behind them.
 
• The discipline is generally agreed to have begun with the **discovery by Nathaniel Kleitman **and his student Eugene Aserinsky** in 1955 **of regular cycles in human sleep, in the sleep laboratory at the** University of Chicago.**
 
 

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
 

 **Morphology**
 It s a branch of biology dealing with the study of the form and structure of organisms and their specific structural features.
 
 

 **Kalology**
 Kalology is the study of facial beauty and the way in which our beauty affects our lifestyle and role in society.
 
 

 **Entomology**
 It is the scientific study of insects, a branch of zoology.
